coverage_questions: The Supplementary information is not included, so the exact instruction templates, lexical serialization, masking policy details, and graph-context textual layouts cannot be reconstructed.
The paper states that CellHermes-w is an expression-weighted average of gene embeddings, but the catalog has no operation for weighted aggregation; the averaging computation remains unresolved.
For predictor routes, task-specific instruction layouts are delegated to Supplementary Note 6, so exact field order and token formatting are unspecified.

The paper does not specify whether predictor inputs use raw gene-expression values, ranked genes, or another textual profile representation when gene expression is included; it explicitly states that expression values were not incorporated for perturbation prediction.
The exact tokenizer vocabulary, special tokens, padding, attention masks, and target-loss masking are not documented.

The paper does not establish whether CellHermes pretraining is a separate lifecycle phase from LoRA fine-tuning; this reconstruction labels the corpus-construction routes pretraining and downstream task adaptation routes fine_tuning.
